description: Exact cents-per-point for an award vs the cash fare, in the trip currency: (cash − award fees − what paying cash would earn) ÷ points × 100. When the award is paid by transferring bank points, pass bank + program: it applies the traveler's transfer ratio (e.g. Belgian Amex to Flying Blue is 2:1) and any active bonus, and judges the value per bank point spent. Call it for every award you compare, rather than doing the maths yourself.

cash_back_pct.description: Cash/crypto back % the traveler would earn paying cash (e.g. 4 for a 4% card). Null if unknown.

currency.description: Currency of all prices, e.g. "EUR", "USD", "GBP". Cash fare and award fees must be in the same currency; convert first if they differ.

award_fees.description: Taxes, fees and surcharges paid on the award

bank.description: Bank currency transferred to pay for it (same keys as transfer_options, e.g. amex_mr_be), or null if the miles are already in the program

bank_points.description: Bank points spent if you already know it (overrides the ratio lookup); else null

cash_price.description: Cash fare for the same flight

miles.description: Miles/points the award costs in the airline or hotel program

miles_earned_paying_cash.description: Airline miles the cash ticket would earn (award tickets usually earn none); null if unknown

program.description: Program slug the miles are in, e.g. "flyingblue", "avios_ba", "aeroplan"; needed with bank

points_per_unit_paying_cash.description: Card points earned per dollar/euro on the cash fare (e.g. 5 for Amex Platinum on flights). Null if unknown.

name: points_value
title: Points or cash verdict
